Package edu.cnu.mdi.mapping

Class MapConstants

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.MapConstants
public final class MapConstants extends Object
Package-wide constants shared across the MDI mapping subsystem.

Centralizing these values eliminates the duplication bugs that arise when the same magic number is defined independently in multiple classes (e.g., MAX_POP_SLIDER_VALUE previously appeared separately in both MapControlPanel and MapView2D, creating a silent divergence risk).

All fields are public static final. This class is not instantiable.

  • Field Details

    • MAX_POP_SLIDER_VALUE

      public static final int MAX_POP_SLIDER_VALUE
      Maximum value (inclusive) of the minimum-population slider used by MapControlPanel and the initial population threshold applied in MapView2D.setProjection(EProjection).

      Cities whose recorded population is below the slider's current value are hidden. At the slider maximum every city is hidden; at zero every city with a known population is shown.

      See Also:

    • DEFAULT_PROJECTION

      public static final EProjection DEFAULT_PROJECTION
      The default map projection shown when a new MapView2D is created and the projection selected in MapProjectionMenu on first render.

      Keeping this constant in one place ensures the view and the menu always agree on which projection is initially active.

    • RADIUS_EARTH_KM
